rationale.ai-review: GPT-4 agents inspect code, detect defects, and recommend improvements.
rationale.framework: Reusable four-agent review architecture coordinates specialized analysis roles.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented the agents and report preliminary system executions.
rationale.general-code: Reviewed source code is not identified as AI-generated.
rationale.risk-quality: System mitigates smells, maintainability problems, redundancy, and performance issues.
